 NFL News Roundup NFL news roundup: Bills' C.J. Gardner-Johnson suspended one game; Texans' Tank Dell to play Week 7
 Published: Updated: Loading... Around the NFL Staff NFL.com Share Facebook Share Twitter NFL.com keeps you up to date with all of the latest league news from around the NFL. Visit NFL.com's transaction hub for a daily breakdown. 
 Atlanta Falcons 2-4 SIGNINGS 
 QB Andy Dalton : Dalton, 38, was released by the Eagles on Oct. 9. He threw an interception on his lone attempt on the 2026 season, briefly replacing Jalen Hurts in a Week 3 loss to Chicago.
 ROSTER CUTS 
 QB Cooper Rush : Rush started Atlanta's first two games as  Tua Tagovailoa and Michael Penix Jr. dealt with injuries, completing 22 of 39 passes for 229 yards, one TD and four INTs in two losses.
 Baltimore Ravens 4-2 INJURIES 
 QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is day to day and could "potentially" return to practice Wednesday, coach Jesse Minter said Monday. Jackson hasn't played the last two weeks.
 Buffalo Bills 5-1 SIGNINGS 
 CB Tre'Davious White (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 CB A.J. Woods (practice squad)
 SUSPENSIONS 
 S C.J. Gardner-Johnson was suspended one game by the NFL for "an act of unsportsmanlike conduct during Sunday’s game" against the Raiders, the league announced. Gardner-Johnson was ejected after he spit at a Raiders player during the second quarter of Buffalo's 33-30 win.
 Cincinnati Bengals 3-2 INJURIES 
 TE Tanner Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve.
 Chicago Bears 4-2 SIGNINGS 
 DB Kenechukwu Eziomume (practice squad)
 Detroit Lions 3-2 SIGNINGS 
 WR DeAndre Carter (practice squad)
 Green Bay Packers 4-2 SIGNINGS 
 DT Mazi Smith is expected to sign to Green Bay's practice squad, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
 INJURIES 
 DE Micah Parsons (knee) will not practice this week, coach Matt LaFleur said Monday. Parsons remains on the physically unable to perform list.
 OTHER NEWS 
 RB Josh Jacobs was officially taken off the Commissioner's Exempt List, per the transaction wire.
 Houston Texans 2-4 ROSTER CUTS 
 LB Aiden Fisher 
 DB Collin Wright 
 INJURIES 
 WR Tank Dell will play in Sunday's game against the Giants, head coach DeMeco Ryans said. The game will mark Dell's first appearance since he tore his ACL, MCL, LCL, dislocated his knee cap and damaged his meniscus in Week 16 of the 2024 season.
 Indianapolis Colts 2-4 FIRINGS 
 GM Chris Ballard was relieved of his duties after a 2-4 start to his 10th season as general manager.
 INJURIES 
 CB Sauce Gardner is considered week to week after suffering a mild calf strain in Sunday's loss to Tennessee, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported.
 Las Vegas Raiders 3-3 SIGNINGS 
 OT Amari Kight (practice squad)
 OT Darian Kinnard (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 TE Chris Myarick (practice squad)
 OL Evan Neal (practice squad)
 Los Angeles Rams 2-4 INJURIES 
 WR Davante Adams is expected to miss six to 10 weeks after suffering a hamstring injury in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals, per head coach Sean McVay. Adams is expected to have a procedure on his hamstring tendon to clean it out, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported.
 DE Myles Garrett (knee) is not expected to return to practice this week, per McVay.
 DT Poona Ford will miss the remainder of the season after suffering a ruptured triceps, per McVay.
 DT Kobie Turner (groin) will be placed on injured reserve, sidelining him at least four weeks, per McVay.
 K  Blake Grupe was placed on injured reserve. Grupe suffered a knee injury in the first half Sunday. Grupe was making his debut for the Rams after he was signed off the Jets' practice squad last week.
 SUSPENSIONS 
 OT Alaric Jackson was activated following his one-game suspension, per the transaction wire.
 WORKOUTS 
 K Brandon McManus is scheduled for a work out with the Rams on Tuesday, NFL Network's Mike Garafolo reported. 
 K Matt Prater is scheduled for a work out with the Rams on Tuesday, Garafolo reported.
 Minnesota Vikings 5-0 INJURIES 
 RB Jordan Mason (thumb) was designated to return to practice from injured reserve.
 New England Patriots 4-2 INJURIES 
 WR Romeo Doubs was placed on injured reserve after suffering a shoulder injury in Sunday's win over the Jets.
 SIGNINGS 
 WR Ryan Miller (practice squad)
 G Andrew Rupcich (practice squad)
 OL Jacob Rizy (practice squad)
 DB  Elliott Davison was signed to the active roster from the practice squad.
 ROSTER CUTS 
 CB D'Shawn Jamison (practice squad)
 New Orleans Saints 2-4 INJURIES 
 WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) made the trip to Paris ahead of New Orleans' Week 7 game against Pittsburgh, coach Kellen Moore said. Tyson is currently on injured reserve.
 Philadelphia Eagles 2-4 INJURIES 
 QB Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the 2026 season as he undergoes treatments for blood clots , NFL Network and ESPN reported.
 San Francisco 49ers 5-0 INJURIES 
 WR Christian Kirk (calf) was downgraded to out ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.
 ROSTER CUTS 
 G Brett Toth was released from injured reserve with an injury settlement.
 GAME DAY ELEVATIONS 
 WR Malik Turner 
 LB Jalen Graham 
 Seattle Seahawks 3-3 INJURIES 
 TE Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) is likely to be placed on injured reserve, Fowler reported. Arroyo suffered the injury in last Thursday night's loss to Denver.
 G Anthony Bradford was designated to return to practice. Bradford is currently on injured reserve.
 SIGNINGS 
 FB Jackson Acker (practice squad)
 TE  Josiah Deguara (practice squad)
 ROSTER CUTS 
 RB Dontae McMillan (practice squad)
 WR Malick Meiga (practice squad)
 Tampa Bay Buccaneers 1-5 INJURIES 
 QB Baker Mayfield (right thumb) is expected to practice Wednesday, coach Todd Bowles said. Mayfield hasn't played or practiced since Week 3.
 Tennessee Titans 1-5 ROSTER CUTS 
 DB Erick Hallett 
 Washington Commanders 1-3-1 INJURIES 
 RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) was placed on injured reserve.
 RB Jeremy McNichols (quad) was activated off IR ahead of Monday's game against the 49ers.
 LB Javontae Jean-Baptiste (pectoral) was placed on IR.
 LB  Jordan Magee (hamstring) was activated off IR.
 CB Trey Amos (ankle) was activated off IR.
 ROSTER CUTS 
 LB Austin Keys 
 GAME DAY ELEVATIONS 
 LB T.J. Maguranyanga
